In the paper, mean A1 receptive-field diameter was 10.9 deg; V1 was 3.9 deg. Drag the A1 diameter to feel how quickly "a cell's patch of visual world" becomes coarse.

A1 receptive-field diameter
18.0 deg

A1 did not merely shift its map into the periphery. Even when the authors matched eccentricity below 30 deg, A1 fields were still larger: 9.7 deg versus 3.9 deg.
